scientific_integrity: The proof is analytic and the standalone finite checker is corroborating evidence; no independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Two synchronous independent non-lazy simple random walks on unweighted K_{n,n}, n>=2, two initial vertices counted at t=0; exact optimality for probability of full vertex coverage by fixed deadline, not expected cover time or general graphs.
title: Parity-optimal two-walker cover starts on balanced complete bipartite graphs
